```python
def wire_parse(frame, plen):
    # returns ('data', psn, payload) | ('ack', psn) | None
    if len(frame) < 58: return None
    if frame[12:14] != b'\x08\x00': return None
    ip = frame[14:]
    ip_len = int.from_bytes(ip[2:4],'big')
    if ip_len + 14 != len(frame): return None
    if ip[0] != 0x45: return None
    if ip[9] != 17: return None
    s = sum(int.from_bytes(ip[i:i+2],'big') for i in range(0,20,2))
    while s >> 16: s = (s & 0xffff) + (s >> 16)
    if s != 0xffff: return None
    flags = int.from_bytes(ip[6:8],'big')
    if flags not in (0, 0x4000): return None
    udp = ip[20:]
    udp_len = int.from_bytes(udp[4:6],'big')
    if udp_len != ip_len - 20 or udp_len < 24: return None
    if udp[0:2] != b'\x12\xb7' or udp[2:4] != b'\x12\xb7': return None
    if udp[6:8] != b'\x00\x00': return None
    bth = udp[8:]
    if bth[1] != 0 or bth[2:4] != b'\xff\xff' or bth[4] != 0: return None
    psn = int.from_bytes(bth[9:12],'big')
    if bth[0] == 4:
        if bth[8] != 0x80: return None
        if udp_len != 24 + plen: return None
        payload = bth[12:12+plen]
        kind='data'
    elif bth[0] == 0x11:
        if bth[8] != 0 or udp_len != 28: return None
        if bth[12] != 0x1f: return None
        if int.from_bytes(bth[13:16],'big') != ((psn+1) & M24): return None
        kind='ack'; payload=None
    else: return None
    # icrc
    crc = icrc(frame)
    if crc != frame[-4:]: return None
    return (kind, psn, payload)
```

Note the checksum check: sum including the checksum field, folded, must equal 0xffff (i.e., ~sum & 0xffff == 0). In my C code I check `(sum & 0xffff) != 0xffff` → invalid. Equivalent ✓.

icrc:
```python
def icrc(frame):
    ip_len = int.from_bytes(frame[16:18],'big')
    buf = bytearray(b'\xff'*8 + frame[14:14+ip_len-4])
    buf[9]=255; buf[16]=255; buf[18:20]=b'\xff\xff'; buf[34:36]=b'\xff\xff'; buf[40]=255
    return struct.pack('<I', zlib.crc32(bytes(buf)))
```

```python
def endpoint_ok(frame, rank, is_data, psn, K, root, primitive, start):
    if frame[0:6] != bytes((2,1,0,0,0,rank+1)): return False
    if frame[6:12] != bytes((2,0,0,0,0,rank+1)): return False
    if frame[26:30] != bytes((10,0,0,rank+1)): return False
    if frame[30:34] != bytes((10,0,0,101+rank)): return False
    bth = frame[14+20+8:]
    qpn = int.from_bytes(bth[4:8],'big')
    if qpn != 0x200+rank: return False
    if is_data:
        if primitive=='broadcast' and rank != root: return False
        if (psn - start) % (1<<24) >= K: return False
    return True
```
